description: The longer blog articles on jsplinter.nl, newest first, each with date, summary, tags, reading time and URL. Optional: words to look for (any word may match) and a tag filter. Call get_post with a slug for the full text.

query.description: Optional words to look for in title, summary and text, e.g. "mcp server". Max 120 characters.

tag.description: Optional tag key as returned by list_tags, e.g. "mcp".

name: list_posts
title: List blog posts
